row_guide: Band0 (y0–768): yellow/tan + grey-blue modular condo stacks (roof/mid-window/ground-door strips, narrow fillers); brown apartment kit (frames, door row, flower-box windows red/orange/blue/white, basement vents, satellite/antenna); assembled brown tall/med/short examples; snow flat+slope roofs and brown rooftop access sheds. Band1 (y768–1536): red-brick modular system (straight/bay-corner/1-floor, white cornice+parapet, arched stone entrances, carpet steps); roof access sheds; street props (hedges, bushes, benches, signs); laundry clotheslines; blue 3-story storefront. Band2 (y1536–2304): more red-brick arch/shutter modules; teal/grey/tan commercial storefront stacks; grey-stone complex with arched window bands, garage door, stair entry; pitched glass skylight + HVAC/vents. Band3 (y2304–3072): balcony/stair/fire-escape strips, beige pipe facade (porthole+Juliet), HVAC fans, HARDWARE sign+hammer, striped awnings (red/cream + blue/yellow), info kiosks, flyers/posters; EXAMPLES row-houses, hardware commercial complex, fire-escape tower. Band4 (y3072–3200): beige detail slice (cat poster, graffiti, trash, pipes) + hardware storefront close-up.
